name: agent-workflows-runner
description: This repository is its own marketplace: it hosts the agent-workflows-runner plugin from the same tree it develops it in, so the placed copy and the tested copy are one thing.

plugins.name: agent-workflows-runner
plugins.description: Five skills that answer one question about a codebase: if every test passes, what is now known to work? analysis-sut derives what the system must do from the code, review-ci-system says what the tests prove and what they do not, create-test writes what is missing at system level or above, prune-test removes what only restates internal structure, and remove-stale-files clears what earlier versions of this plugin left behind. A YAML test runner ships alongside them for the end-to-end checks a project's own framework cannot reach.
